Grouped only because they all contend for, or ride on, the single VE.Direct port." Sharing a physical port is not sharing a map. gotchas: A product has ONE VE.Direct port. If an MPPT Control, a Bluetooth dongle or a GX cable is on it, nothing else can be. That is the real trade a cabin faces: BLE advertisement (fewer fields, encrypted, needs the paired key) OR the serial cable (full text and HEX), never both.

The SmartSolar Pluggable Display is the exception and it is worth knowing. The MPPT Control does occupy the VE.Direct port. Victron describes it as connecting via the 'VE.Direct communications port'; the vendor page names it a monitoring and setup device for BlueSolar MPPT charge controllers, housed in the BMV-700 series case. The page does not confirm the retail part number SCC900500000.

ASS030530000 is the vendor's own isolation answer — 3.34: 'provides a virtual comport through USB as well as galvanic isolation'. Prefer it over a bare three-wire tap on the JST-PH header. Note pin 4 carries Power+ and pin 1 is GND; run only GND/RX/TX to a gateway.
